newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Petrobras, YPF on JV talks - paper.
newsitem.headline: Petrobras, YPF on JV talks - paper.

text.p: Brazil's Petroleo Brasileiro SA - Petrobras and Argentina's YPF Sociedad Anonima are holding talks for the creation of a binational company, the Jornal do Brasil daily said on Thursday.

The newspaper said the two companies plan to join forces to be well prepared to compete with the multinationals entering the Brazilian oil market following regulations concerning the opening up of the country's oil sector.
"Other players will appear and we have to be prepared," Jayme Barroso, director at Petrobras' Braspetro, was quoted as saying.

Jornal do Brasil said the two firms have been negotiating seven projects estimated at $1 billion, including the construction of YPF/Petrobras gas stations as recently announced by Petrobras president Joel Renno.
